review:
Bow of Artemis is an 8x8 cluster slot with bears, wolves and deer, where clusters of five or more win and tumble. Coloured marked spots award different modifiers when they're part of a win, from transforming wilds and colossal symbols to clearing the board and refilling it.

Winning symbols are collected towards Gold Fever: 114 symbols unlock the first level, which applies 2x to all wins, and further levels raise it. The RTP is 96.05%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on its page. It's a spiritual successor to Gems Bonanza.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
